pages.title: Discover JGU
pages.intro: A private university with a public purpose - meet the people, ideas and values behind O.P. Jindal Global University.

blocks.text: Welcome to JGU

O.P. Jindal Global University (JGU) is a multidisciplinary, research-driven university in Sonipat, Haryana. Founded with the belief that a private university can serve the public good, JGU brings together students, scholars and practitioners from across India and the world.

16000+ | Students
1100+ | Faculty & Staff
620+ | International Collaborations
22400+ | Alumni Network
10730+ | Publications
Our vision

To build a world-class institution that nurtures critical thinkers, ethical leaders and responsible global citizens - and that contributes new knowledge to society through teaching, research and public engagement.
What makes JGU different

Interdisciplinary learning that connects law, business, public policy, the humanities and the social sciences
A global outlook with exchange, study-abroad and joint-degree partnerships across continents
Research and teaching led by experienced scholars and practitioners
A residential campus designed for learning, sport, culture and community
Explore Study at JGU

discover-jgu.title: Discover JGU
discover-jgu.intro: Explore the story, of KMS School vision and everyday life of a university built on the idea of a global education rooted in public service.

blocks.text: A university with a global outlook

O.P. Jindal Global University (JGU) is a non-profit, multidisciplinary university located in Sonipat, Haryana. Since its founding it has set out to build an institution that combines academic rigour with a strong sense of social responsibility, and that prepares graduates to lead in India and across the world.

JGU brings together students and faculty from many countries, disciplines and backgrounds. Classrooms are small and discussion-driven, programmes are designed to cross traditional boundaries, and every student is encouraged to pair what they learn in lectures with internships, research, community work and time abroad.
Our vision and mission
To promote global education that is relevant, interdisciplinary and rooted in public service, so that graduates can contribute meaningfully to society.

bullets.text: Provide teaching of the highest quality in an environment that values curiosity and debate
Encourage original research that addresses real social, economic and policy challenges

Maintain a diverse, inclusive and safe community for every student and staff member

Student life at JGU is as important as the curriculum. The campus offers modern classrooms, studios and labs, a well-stocked library, sports facilities, dining options, residential blocks and on-campus healthcare — all within walking distance of each other.

blocks.text: Learning that goes beyond lectures

Studying at JGU means being an active participant in your own education. Courses are built around discussion, writing, problem-solving and collaboration. Faculty act as mentors who challenge students to think independently and to connect ideas from different fields.

Programmes follow a flexible, credit-based structure. In the early semesters students build a broad foundation; later they deepen their expertise in a major and may add a minor, an honours track or a research project.

O.P. Jindal Global University is a non-profit, multidisciplinary university dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and public service. Established in Sonipat, Haryana, it has grown into an international institution with students, faculty and partners across the globe.
